text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first three years with Still in Love 
have come to an end—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Arrangements were made for a long-term 
hospitalization to confront a body that 
only continued to deteriorate.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Please, rest well. Everything will be 
just fine, I'm sure."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, intuition strikes. —I had a 
feeling I would never see her again.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Good night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her reaction, I became certain. 
Still in Love—intends to disappear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Then there is only one thing left to do.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Farewell—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!? Weren't you supposed to be in 
the hospital...?
choice_data_list:
I took care of the cancellation 
procedures.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Either way, I knew the cause couldn't be 
determined. If so... I wanted to 
prioritize her over myself.
choice_data_list: You don't have to go anywhere.
You don't have to go anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...However, if you do that... you 
will...—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—I have a vague sense of what this 
decision will lead to. Even so, the sight 
I seek above all else is..."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
(Defeating every single top contender!! 
Delivering a masterclass of a run! The 
victor is...—)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
StillinLoveStillinLoveStillinLove 
StillinLoveStillinLoveStillinLove 
StillinLoveStillinLoveStillinLove

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In love Still in love Still in love Still 
in love Still in love Still in love Still 
in love Still in love
choice_data_list:
—You're allowed to keep making your dreams 
come true.

—You're allowed to keep making your dreams 
come true.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list:
Let's run, Still— run and keep running and 
keep running

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ――Aah...! Finally.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Just now... we became one.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"We don't have to part anymore. Nothing 
can tear us apart now. Because—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Y o u c a m e a l l t h e w a y h e r e

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The darkness deepens. While people 
slumber, the one who reigns in their stead 
is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—They are creatures that live in the 
night.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I am ready.
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we start training?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Um, those crimson eyes of yours... I think 
they're really, really pretty.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes... Ufufufu...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Let us claim victory. Against each and 
every formidable opponent."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Let us taste every single pleasure this 
world has to offer together...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Until this instinct is satisfied—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Alwaaays.
